reason: All linux_riscv64 CI jobs fail with a solver error: "No candidates were found for cross-python_linux-riscv64 *". This is a missing ecosystem dependency (the riscv64 cross-Python package is not yet available in conda-forge), not a bug in pydantic-core. All other platforms (linux_64, linux_aarch64, linux_ppc64le, win_64, osx_64, osx_arm64) pass cleanly.
